items.html: And behold, even though we said above that the Daat of the time of nursing is only in an inclusive manner, because only the Gevura and not the Hesed is recognizable in it, nevertheless it is certain that it also includes Hassadim and Gevurot, even though the Hassadim are not recognizable. It thus follows that there must be there two Names of Elokim, and both of them are in the filling with Alephs. But the difference between them is that in the letter Hei of the Elokim that is in the Hesed of the Daat, that Aleph of its filling has the form Yud-Vav-Yud, while the letter Aleph within the Hei of the Elokim of the Gevura of the Daat has the form Yud-Vav-Dalet, as mentioned in the Tikkunim. For there are two forms within the Aleph: Yud-Vav-Yud and Yud-Vav-Dalet.
